records.subject: Haven't seen you in Wrenfield lately
records.body:
Hi Kai,

It looks like setup stalled before the first project. If it would help, I can set up your first project with you so there's less to figure out on your own.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Summit Analytics set up
records.body:
Hi Kai,

Thanks for joining Wrenfield. If this is your first project-management tool for the team, the biggest adjustment is usually just getting into the habit of logging tasks here instead of a doc or a chat thread.

Happy to help with that transition.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: 6 days in with no project, no invite, no milestone and zero replies to the welcome email [email:bd5be5dc]; no tickets, so no engagement signal at all. Starter plan, single admin, 8 days left. Accounts silent through the first week rarely self-activate.

draft.subject: A hand getting your first project started
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

Checking in after my welcome note last week. You haven't set up a first project in Wrenfield yet, and that's the usual starting point "" projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and whenever you're ready to bring the team in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through your first project with you and answer anything about moving work over from docs or chat.

Best,
Nadia
